module.title: Security checker
module.description: CheckSecurity checks host security posture: certificate expiry and (on Windows) the firewall profile state.
module.name: CheckSecurity

check_certificate.description: Check X.509 certificate expiry/validity/hygiene from files (all platforms) or the Windows certificate store.

check_firewall.description: Check the Windows firewall profile (Domain/Private/Public) enabled state. Windows only.

check_firewall_rules.description: Check individual Windows firewall rules: assert that specific rules exist and are enabled, and find inbound allow rules that restrict neither address nor port. Windows only.

check_users.description: Check the count and detail of logged-on / RDP sessions (Windows and Linux).

check_nla.description: Check the Network Location Awareness profile (public/private/domain) per network. Windows only.

check_antivirus.description: Check registered antivirus products' enabled/up-to-date state (Windows Security Center). Windows only.

check_bitlocker.description: Check BitLocker drive-encryption protection status per volume. Windows only.

check_secureboot.description: Check whether UEFI Secure Boot is enabled. Windows only.

check_defender.description: Check Microsoft Defender status: signature/scan age, real-time and tamper protection, engine/signature versions. Windows only.

check_local_accounts.description: Check local user account hygiene: enabled/disabled, locked, password-required/expires, built-in admin/guest. Windows only.

check_group_members.description: Check local group membership (default Administrators) and alert on members not on an expected allow-list. Windows only.

check_activation.description: Check the Windows activation/licensing state: license status, remaining grace or KMS renewal period and genuineness. Windows only.

check_file_security.description: Check the owner and DACL of files, folders or service binaries; alerts on world-writable paths and unexpected owners. Windows only.
